question_record.context: A recent multi-stage security incident detected the dropping of multiple known dual-purpose tools, such as `mimikatz.exe` and various PowerShell scripts, on a device associated with the account `tgs2z`. These tools could have been used for credential theft, escalation of privileges, or lateral movement by attackers.
question_record.question: What is the malicious URL that was delivered in the email messages and later removed?
solution: Multiple dual-purpose tools were dropped on the device by a user with AadUserId `1d94aaf6-efe6-4e76-ad56-ffd7d1257bc1`.
An email containing a malicious URL `https://ac27145722.livelygrass-8d4c4013.eastus2.azurecontainerapps.io/` was delivered and later removed.

62.name: Multiple dual-purpose tools were dropped
62.description:
Multiple known public tools, which could also be used for malicious reasons were dropped on this device.
Attackers might download or copy multiple dual-purpose tools to the target device to perform various attack stages including, credential theft, privilege escalation, and lateral movement.

       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
